git add internal/cli/semantic.go internal/cli/viz.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(viz): trim chunked-merge buffer early; set full HTTP timeout set

Copilot round-11 findings:

- findSemanticRelationsForSymbolsInSQLite accumulated every chunk's rows
  until the final sort+trim, so peak memory was O(chunks x limit) in the
  worst case. The merge buffer is now trimmed to the smallest `limit`
  rowids whenever it doubles past the limit (rebuilding the dedup set to
  match); a trimmed row re-arriving from a later batch is dropped again by
  the final trim, so the result is unchanged.
- The viz http.Server now sets ReadTimeout/WriteTimeout/IdleTimeout/
  MaxHeaderBytes alongside the existing ReadHeaderTimeout, so a local
  client holding connections open can't pin goroutines indefinitely.
  WriteTimeout is generous (5m) because it spans handler time and a maxed
  slider legitimately produces a large response.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
